# jumpcloud_role (Data Source)

Looks up an admin role, such as `Read Only` or a custom role, by its name. Use it to give a `jumpcloud_service_account` a role. Fails unless exactly one role matches.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "jumpcloud_role" "read_only" {
  name = "Read Only"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Role name, matched exactly and case-sensitively.

### Read-Only

- `custom` (Boolean) Whether the organization created the role, rather than JumpCloud.
- `description` (String) Role description.
- `id` (String) Role ID.
